title: Homology stalk compatibility of exchange in a commuting cube
statement: Let S,T,X,X',S0,T0,X0,X1 be schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let g:T->S, f:X->S, g':X'->X, f':X'->T, jA:S0->S, jB:T0->T, g0:T0->S0, p0:X0->X, f0:X0->S0, p1:X1->X0, f1:X1->T0, b:X1->X' make all four squares (g',f',f,g), (p0,f0,f,jA), (p1,f1,f0,g0), (b,f1,f',jB) commute, and suppose jB g=g0 jA and b g'=p1 p0. For an abelian etale sheaf G [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] set K=G[0], K0=(p0^*G)[0], M1=g^*Rf_*K, M2=Rf'_*g'^*K, N1=g0^*Rf0_*K0, N2=Rf1_*p1^*K0 [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Let u1:jB^*M1->N1 be inverse-image composition along jB g=g0 jA followed by g0^* of the exchange for (p0,f0,f,jA), followed by the inverse-image single-complex comparison. Let u2:jB^*M2->N2 be the exchange for (b,f1,f',jB) followed by inverse-image composition along b g'=p1 p0 and the inverse-image single-complex comparison. For a separably closed field k, points t:Spec k->T0, s:Spec k->T with t jB=s, and q in Z, form r_i:(H^q M_i)_s -> (H^q N_i)_t by the inverse-image stalk comparison followed by H^q(u_i) [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. If e and e0 are H^q of the original and local exchange maps [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange], then r1 followed by (e0)_t equals e_s followed by r2. No isomorphism of r_i or e is asserted.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tags 03Q9 (theorem-higher-direct-images, restriction of section complexes) and 095T (theorem-proper-base-change, final stalk calculation); cube compatibility is the formal horizontal-mate-pasting calculation. Online Stacks text read by Y2.

proof.text: Form the two commuting outer squares with horizontal maps b g′, jB g and p1 p0, g0 jA. Apply derivedBaseChangeMapPlus_paste_horiz to sq followed by sqB and to sq0 followed by sq1, at K. Transport the outer mate along h and hb by equality elimination; commutativity witnesses agree by proof irrelevance. Precompose the transported equality by the inverse composition isomorphism for jB,g and postcompose by Rf1 of the composition isomorphism for p1,p0. Associativity, functoriality, and the hom/inv identities cancel the adjacent inverse factors, yielding the derived cube identity before the single-complex comparison.

Apply naturality of the local derived mate to the inverse-image/single-complex comparison for p0. Postcompose the derived cube identity with Rf1 of p1 inverse image of this comparison. Reassociate and use functoriality to obtain the equality between exchangeCubeSourceComparison followed by the local mate and jB inverse image of the original mate followed by exchangeCubeTargetComparison.

Prove postcomposition functoriality of derivedStalkComparison by substituting s=t jB and using the homology and point fibre functors’ composition laws. Prove precomposition naturality by the inverse-image stalk isomorphism’s inverse naturality, then the exact inverse-image/homology isomorphism’s hom naturality. Rewrite both sides of the target with these two formulas and the derived cube identity. This works for every degree and every commuting cube, including zero complexes and identity cubes.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $S,T,X,X',S_0,T_0,X_0,X_1$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let
$g\colon T\to S$, $f\colon X\to S$, $g'\colon X'\to X$, $f'\colon X'\to T$,
$j_A\colon S_0\to S$, $j_B\colon T_0\to T$, $g_0\colon T_0\to S_0$, $p_0\colon X_0\to X$,
$f_0\colon X_0\to S_0$, $p_1\colon X_1\to X_0$, $f_1\colon X_1\to T_0$ and $b\colon X_1\to X'$
be morphisms such that the four squares

$$
f\circ g'=g\circ f',\qquad f\circ p_0=j_A\circ f_0,\qquad f_0\circ p_1=g_0\circ f_1,\qquad
f'\circ b=j_B\circ f_1
$$

commute, and suppose $g\circ j_B=j_A\circ g_0$ and $g'\circ b=p_0\circ p_1$. For an abelian
étale sheaf $G$ on $X$ put $K=G[0]$, $K_0=(p_0^*G)[0]$ and

$$
M_1=g^*Rf_*K,\qquad M_2=Rf'_*g'^*K,\qquad N_1=g_0^*Rf_{0*}K_0,\qquad N_2=Rf_{1*}p_1^*K_0
$$

([def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]). Let
$u_1\colon j_B^*M_1\to N_1$ be the inverse-image composition isomorphism along
$g\circ j_B=j_A\circ g_0$, followed by $g_0^*$ of the exchange map of the square
$f\circ p_0=j_A\circ f_0$, followed by the comparison of inverse image with single complexes.
Let $u_2\colon j_B^*M_2\to N_2$ be the exchange map of the square $f'\circ b=j_B\circ f_1$,
followed by the inverse-image composition isomorphism along $g'\circ b=p_0\circ p_1$ and the
comparison of inverse image with single complexes. Let $k$ be a separably closed field,
$t\colon\operatorname{Spec}k\to T_0$ and $s\colon\operatorname{Spec}k\to T$ points with
$j_B\circ t=s$, and $q\in\mathbf Z$. Let $r_i\colon(H^qM_i)_s\to(H^qN_i)_t$ be the
inverse-image stalk comparison followed by the map induced by $H^q(u_i)$
[def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. If $e\colon H^qM_1\to H^qM_2$ and
$e_0\colon H^qN_1\to H^qN_2$ are $H^q$ of the exchange maps
[def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] of the squares $f\circ g'=g\circ f'$ and
$f_0\circ p_1=g_0\circ f_1$, then

$$
(e_0)_t\circ r_1=r_2\circ e_s .
$$

No isomorphism of $r_i$ or $e$ is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the proved horizontal pasting law for the derived exchange to the original square followed by the square over jB, and to the square over jA followed by the local square over g0. The outer mates agree because their horizontal maps agree by the two cube equations. Cancel the composition isomorphisms. Insert the inverse-image/single-complex comparison by naturality of the local mate. ([lemma-weil-pbc-derived-exchange-coherence]).

Apply homology and the fibre functor. Naturality of the exact inverse-image/homology comparison and of the inverse-image stalk comparison transports the resulting equality to the two stalk comparison maps $r_1,r_2$ of the statement. This is a formal calculation, with no invertibility assumption on either mate. ([def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-stalk-germ]).
